A used-up enchanted book. Stacks to 64.
Where it comes from: merging books, clearing enchantments, dropping a level I book, or a master tome running out of charges. Also found in chests and in wild chiseled bookshelves.
What to do with it: turn it back into a plain book at the table, or store it in a chiseled bookshelf — it still counts toward your shelf total.
Librarians: 2 scrolls buy 1 Emerald or 2 Amethyst Shards, and they repair plain books from Novice level.
Rewriting one into an enchanted book costs more (and needs a higher-level librarian) the rarer, more universal and higher-level the enchantment is — but always less than a vanilla Mending trade.

1.0.3 Classic

This chapter describes Standard-mode systems. In 1.0.3 Classic they are disabled: no resonance discounts, tome wear/regen, Treasure Epiphany, cleanse or transcription slip — inscriptions are instant at full XP cost.
Crafting & Quick Start
Dual manual recipes, table crafting/upgrades & cloth dyeing
Craft the Grimoire two ways, and craft the table directly or upgrade a vanilla one.
Grimoire (Shapeless): Book & Quill + Chiseled Shelf, OR Depleted Tome + Ink Sac.

Table (Shaped): 1 Book + 2 Diamonds + 1 Chiseled Bookshelf + 3 Crying Obsidian. Already own a vanilla table? Upgrade it with 4 Amethyst Shards + 1 Chiseled Bookshelf + 3 Crying Obsidian and save the diamonds.
Click #1-#7 on the right to inspect all 7 live recipes; click any item for JEI/REI.
Right-click the table with dyes to blend cloth colors; store this Grimoire in shelves.
Enchanted Books stack to 64, and anvil merges remove prior-work penalty doubling.

Book Upgrades & Paying the Difference
2-book Combine, 1-book Upgrade & fair step pricing
Two easy ways raise low-level books to MAX, and gear upgrades automatically deduct prior materials:
Combine 2 Books (0 Items): Put matching books in Top & Bottom Slots for 0.6x XP; the lower book turns into 1 Depleted Tome.
Upgrade 1 Book (Save Books): Put 1 book on top + regular materials or 1x Arcane Synthesis Crystal below at 1.4x XP.
Pay the Difference: Upgrading existing gear enchants deducts prior items automatically — and costs just 1–2L with a stored book.

Mending, Swift Sneak, Locking & instant Refresh
Treasures like Mending, Silk Touch, and Swift Sneak have two steady paths (Infinity never rolls here):
Way 1 [Store a Book]: Put any found Treasure Book in a Chiseled Bookshelf for permanent 1–3L single-item enchanting.

Lock Keeps & Infinity Rule
Locking keeps the current rolls even if you break the table and put it back. Infinity is the exception: it only comes from loot chests, random vanilla enchanting, or copying a tome you already own.

Disenchant, Lower Level & Purge Curse
Free wipe, 1-level step-down, strip 1 & curse purge
Switch to the teal Cleanse tab to modify enchanted gear or books in four ways:
Disenchant All (0 Items): Clears all non-curse enchants and spawns XP orbs; emptied books turn into Depleted Tomes.
Lower Level (0 Items): Drops a chosen enchant by 1 level and refunds XP orbs; a solo level I book turns into a Depleted Tome.

Remove one enchantment: on gear with several enchantments, pay 3–10 levels plus either Cleansing Grit with Lapis / Glow Ink Sac / Amethyst, plain Amethyst + Lapis, or 1 Arcane Synthesis Crystal. Everything else stays untouched.

Remove a curse: costs %s levels (bookshelves shave off up to %s%%). Pick one: Cleansing Grit + Ghast Tear/Golden Apple, 2 Ghast Tears + 2 Golden Apples, or 1 Arcane Synthesis Crystal. Every other enchantment stays.

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Chest Storage & Queued Inscribing
The table saves items inside itself just like a Chest — walk away anytime without losing a thing:
Close the screen, travel far away, or quit and reload the world — gear and materials stay safely inside the table.
During a timed ritual, you can click multiple enchantments on the same item to line them up in a single queue.
While inscribing is running, the target slot stays locked for safety; mining the table drops stored items cleanly.
Hands-Free Crafting
Queue several big enchantments, close the menu to go mining or farming, and come back to finished gear!

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Timed Rituals & Two Skip Choices
Waiting ONLY appears when total nearby bookshelves reach %s+ OR stored Template Books total %s+ enchantments:
More total nearby bookshelves, more Tome enchants, higher relative tier, and universal enchants (Infinity, Mending) take longer — capped at 5 min each. Queue cap: 256 steps / 32,000 characters.
[Sacrifice XP Skip]: Directly spends whole XP levels based on remaining time (capped at 15 levels) to finish safely with 0% Tome damage.

3) Rush Skip: Finishes immediately for 0 extra XP, but risks turning a shelf Template Book into a Depleted Tome (up to %s%% for normal books, %s%% for Infinity books; more shelves & less time left lower the risk).
Rush Needs a Tome & Infinity Shield
Sacrifice XP Skip works anytime (even with 0 Tomes); Force Rush requires a nearby Template Book and always spares Infinity Tomes while any non-Infinity Tome exists!

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: How 'Was XX Levels' & Gates Work
Hovering an option shows 'Bookshelf Discount: -X% (Was Y Levels)' — here is what that really means:
[How 'Was Y Levels' is set]: Just like a vanilla Lv.30 table, base gate scales from ~12 up to 30 for max tier (or higher for rare treasures); upgrading existing tiers credits 85% of old progress!
[Use in Green-Orb Mode]: Your entry ticket, NOT full cost! At -40%, 'Was 30' becomes Lv.18 to click — you only spend 1–3 levels and keep XP bar %! This also stops low-level free-XP loops.
[Use in Purple-Flask Mode]: Without a Template Book, the discounted level is actually paid in full — which is why storing a Tome saves tons of XP!
Quick Takeaway
No Tome = pay the full discounted levels (Purple). Stored Tome = just meet the discounted gate and spend 1–3 levels (Green)!

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Game-Day Regen & Infinity Tomes
Stored Template Books heal naturally over game days (%s Total Shelves -> %sd/+1, %s Total Shelves -> %sd/+1):
[Persisted Shelf Healing]: Books in Chiseled Bookshelves recover durability over loaded time (saved across chunk unloads & restarts; cleared if moved) and strip wear tags at full.
[Wear Immunity & Copy Gen]: Wear-immune tomes (e.g. Infinity, Gen ≤2) have 100% wear waiver at ≤4 enchants (-6% per extra enchant down to 30%); Gen >2 copies lose immunity.
[Library Overload Slip <=25%]: Total load ΣL≥3 across nearby wear-immune tomes risks a slip (70% -1 tier / 25% cross-line / 5% curse; 50% XP & item refund).
Best Practice for Infinity
Keep total nearby wear-immune load ΣL<3 and ≤4 enchants per book (Gen ≤2) for 100% wear immunity and 0% slip!

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Bookshelf Taxonomy & Roles
'Bookshelves' fall into clear categories — here is how every type counts across the mod:

[Total Nearby Bookshelves = (1) + (3)]: Includes (1) Regular Bookshelves and (3) Book-Holding Chiseled Bookshelves (≥1 plain book, grimoire, Enchanted Book, or Depleted Tome). Empty Chiseled Shelves (0 books) do not count.
[Book-Holding Chiseled Shelves]: A Chiseled Bookshelf holding plain Books or Depleted Tomes counts as a Broad Bookshelf (not a Template Book); ONLY Enchanted Books also act as Template Books!

3) Wooden Bookshelf: your main progression block! Controls max tier without a Template Book, Wooden XP discount (up to -%s%%), and Treasure Epiphany — while also counting toward total shelves (%s / %s recharge speedups).
Depleted Tomes Keep Your Shelf Tier
If a Template Book degrades into a Depleted Tome, that Chiseled Bookshelf remains an occupied Broad Bookshelf — your 38/42 healing tier never drops!

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: World Remnants & Librarian Trades
Depleted Tomes also spawn across the world and trade exclusively with [Librarian] villagers:

[Chests & Wild Chiseled Shelves]: Found in dungeon, temple, mansion, ancient city & stronghold library chests (10%–55%), plus weathered wild Chiseled Bookshelves (total book replacement strictly <=30%, ~17.8% avg).
[Librarian Buyback]: Exclusively Librarian villagers buy Depleted Tomes at 2 Depleted Tomes = 1 Emerald OR 2 Amethyst Shards.

[Dynamic Villager Rank Gate + Dynamic Price]: Plain Books unlock at Lv.1 (4 Lapis / 2 Ink / 1 Emerald). Rewriting into tradeable Enchanted Books (excluding Epiphany-exclusives, Infinity & Curses) dynamically sets BOTH required Librarian rank (Novice Lv.1 – Master Lv.5) AND price via (Rarity x Universality x Relative Level), capped at 18 Emeralds!
Great Early-Game Boost
Level up village Librarians toward Expert / Master (Lv.4–5) to progressively unlock top-tier tradeable rewrites like Unbreaking III or Fortune III (Epiphany-exclusives & Infinity stay sacred)!

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Pages & Locks
Page Unlocks, Tomes & Locks
Unlock Cleanse and Tomes, then protect charging tomes
The Cleanse and Tomes tabs start locked. Hover a locked tab, then use this chapter to unlock both pages permanently for your player:
[Cleanse] Put Depleted Tomes on nearby Chiseled Bookshelves and press the amber sacrifice button by the tabs. Sacrificing %s total unlocks Cleanse and grants an advancement.
[Tomes] Put Enchanted Books in at least %s nearby Chiseled Bookshelves (same scan as tome charging). The page unlocks and grants “How Much Longer...”.
[Dashboard] The Tomes page lists every template book in range: remaining charges, generation, time to +1 and time to full, plus the shelf count still needed for the next recharge tier.

[Locks] Select a book and lock it until +1, until full, or permanently. Locked books keep charging but cannot be removed or used anywhere. Early unlock costs %s XP level(s) + %s Cleansing Grit; timed locks release themselves.
Lock All & Reminders
Use Lock All Full for every charging book. Timed locks sparkle on the shelf and ping their owner when they expire.
